_doc: This file is the manifest the studio loads at startup. Each entry in `presets`
names a sibling JSON file: ./presets/<id>.json. Adding a preset = drop a new
JSON in this folder and append its id here.
id           string  kebab-case; should match the filename
label        string  shown in the dropdown
palette      string  multiline, same grammar as studio.html textarea
arrangement  string  multiline, same grammar as studio.html textarea
Any other fields (meta, notes, caveats, credits, ...) are ignored by the loader
and free for authoring. The loader also accepts these legacy fallbacks for
